checkpoint_function: checkpoint a function with input tensors to enable recomputation before gradient arrival in Pipe
create_Checkpointing: create a Checkpointing object to generate Checkpoint and Recompute autograd function pairs
enable_checkpointing_context: enable checkpointing context manager to track forward propagation under checkpointing
is_recomputing_check: check if the current forward propagation is under checkpoint recomputation to prevent duplicated side-effects
save_and_restore_rng_states: save and restore PyTorch RNG states between checkpoint forward and recomputation backward passes
